notes_for_editor: Thin record: the Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives only name, county, coordinates and gone status. Unconfirmed lead: a Wisconsin Historical Society photograph (Neighborhood House records, July 1941, country Wisconsin) is captioned Fire tower at Pigeon Lake Boys' Camp, a five-mile hike from the camp per its caption. Nothing in the record ties that Pigeon Lake to Bayfield County or to this tower, so the story only mentions it with that caveat. Its rights status reads COPYRIGHT NOT EVALUATED, so it is not added to photos. A compiled Wisconsin list (centraluslookouts.weebly.com) has a bare PIGEON LAKE entry with no county, which is not used. Worth checking the Wisconsin Historical Society record and Bayfield County sources for the camp's location and any tower history. No build, staffing or removal date was found in the two searches.
